name: Turn and crop
author: Pinhole
description: R turns the photo shown a quarter, Shift R back; K crops it, Shift K takes it back to the original. In iCloud it is saved as an edit of the photo, which the iPhone shows too; a folder's photo keeps it in Pinhole, its file untouched. The grid, the viewer, exports as JPEG and copies show it so, and Ctrl Z undoes it.
